mods.name: WW Prince and Water Sword - Visuals (Steam)
mods.author: Local mod project
mods.description: Original Steam visual edition. WW Prince, separate hair, medallion and Water Sword appearance. Native damage and story weapon progression; no boss aura or opening grant. Requires standard Mod Manager large asset support. No custom runtime DLL bundled.

mods.name: WW Prince and Water Sword - Full (OpenJade)
mods.author: Local mod project
mods.description: OpenJade 0.4.1 only. WW Prince, separate hair and medallion, Water Sword, enhanced damage, boss-only blue aura and opening equip. No custom runtime DLL. Do not install this edition on original Steam.
